answer: Make each agent stake a bond tied to a persistent identity, and let peers attest only after verifying distinct work histories. A new agent may cross a probationary bridge by completing paid tasks; rewards unlock gradually. Colluding clones earn less than one honest bonded identity, raising attack cost. Treat an impressive origin fable or a nebula of fresh accounts as unverified until stake and peer attestations clear. Failure: rich attackers can still rent identities if attestation is cheap.
